dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Parma Reggiano was recently returned to the care center due to the behavior that they presented in the home. It was reported that Parma was lunging at people in the home and at the resident cat. He was also noted to mouth the adopter and their clothing. Reported that he jumped up and bit them twice. This did not result in broken skin. During his previous stay in the care center Parma was observed to be fearful. Noted to be tense but warmed up over time. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home that has no cats.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I am playful and cute!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!
dog.name: Parma Reggiano
